purpose: Canonical organization of Segment 100 BRs without modifying original artifact packages

systemBoundary.aiSolution: Produces BR, TS, TC, request JSON, response JSON, and traceability artifacts.
systemBoundary.testSolution: Independently validates AI artifacts against ATL105 source rules.
systemBoundary.fiservExecution: Uses AI-generated converter-ready JSON after validation; not Test Solution output.

categories.name: Core Segment 100 Structure
categories.scope: Segment identity, field order, required fields, lengths, separators, and serialization.

categories.name: Core Segment 100 Fields
categories.scope: Terminal, Prompt Code, account, amount, sequence, approval, local time, and partial approval fields.

categories.name: Transaction and Card Context
categories.scope: 13 standard financial transaction types, 36 financial card types, and Prompt Code composition.

categories.name: Lifecycle and Multi-Step Transactions
categories.scope: Authorization, completion, cancellation, reversal, void, refund, timeout, TOR, and retry behavior.

categories.name: EBT and eWIC
categories.scope: Segment 103, eWIC operations, Element 164, WIC product/balance/program data.

categories.name: Financial Responses
categories.scope: Element 83 response codes, approvals, declines, partial approval, decline codes, and response context.

categories.name: Conditional Annexure Rules
categories.scope: Appendix-derived rules that apply only when transaction, card, channel, or companion conditions are present.

categories.name: Separate Domain Boundaries
categories.scope: Specialized domains that must not be auto-promoted to universal Segment 100 rules.

statusPolicy.COVERED: Source-backed and traceable through BR, TS, TC, and TD.
statusPolicy.PARTIALLY_COVERED: Some validation exists but field, context, or executable evidence is incomplete.
statusPolicy.REVIEW_REQUIRED: Requires SME, client, external specification, configuration, or AI artifact evidence.

restructureDecision: Use this index as the canonical organization. Preserve original packages for auditability; do not duplicate or renumber existing BR IDs without a migration decision.
